frame_length.description: An integer scalar `Tensor`. The window length in samples.

frame_step.description: An integer scalar `Tensor`. The number of samples to step.

fft_length.description: An integer scalar `Tensor`. The size of the FFT to apply. If not provided, uses the smallest power of 2 enclosing `frame_length`.

window_fn.description: A callable that takes a window length and a `dtype` keyword argument and returns a `[window_length]` `Tensor` of samples in the provided datatype. If set to `None`, no windowing is used.

pad_end.description: Whether to pad the end of `signals` with zeros when the provided frame length and step produces a frame that lies partially past its end.

output.description: A `[..., frames, fft_unique_bins]` `Tensor` of `complex64`/`complex128` STFT values where `fft_unique_bins` is `fft_length // 2 + 1` (the unique components of the FFT).
